summary: Build AI pipelines to convert unstructured documents into structured datasets. Develop parsing, retrieval, and reasoning systems across multi-format industrial data.
responsibilities: Build AI pipelines to convert unstructured documents (BOQs, tenders, specs) into structured datasets.
Develop parsing, retrieval, and reasoning systems across multi-format industrial data.
Fine-tune and deploy LLMs and vision-language models for production use cases.
Design continuous learning loops and retraining workflows.
Collaborate with engineering and product teams to scale prototypes into production-ready systems.
required_skills: Experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.).
Familiarity with Document AI/OCR models (PaddleOCR, LayoutLM, Donut, etc.).
Understanding of embeddings, semantic search, RAG, and entity linking.
Clean coding, modular design, and Git/GitHub proficiency.
nice_to_have_skills: Experience with document understanding or information extraction systems.
Built feedback-based evaluation or retraining pipelines.
AWS experience (S3, Lambda, EC2, SageMaker) for model deployment.
Open-source contributions or published ML projects.
benefits: Competitive compensation and long-term career growth
